label: rare late-input/<DEL> feature in sequences starting with x/1/2/3
explanation: Very sparse (0.009% of steps). Fires almost only in the late original phase (t>=4, highest rate at the last original token) and at the <DEL> step (30% of mass), with essentially no copy-phase activity. It is concentrated in sequences whose first token is x, 1, 2 or 3 (~86% of mass), usually with an early 3 and several digits, and prefers in_tok <DEL>/0/u/v/z/h/q/b and prev_tok b/z/w. These are context conditions only: the best predicate has ~0.2% precision, and adding conditions (seen 3, first occurrence, prev_tok sets) brings precision to only about 1% while recall drops to about 45-60%. The exact trigger is a rare conjunction that no tested predicate captures. Magnitude is fairly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.22), and I did not find anything that modulates it.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=2 (+4.45), orig0=x (+4.37), orig0=1 (+4.12), orig1=3 (+3.60), orig0=3 (+3.53), orig2=3 (+3.34). Lower it: correct=1 (-4.90), phase=2 (-4.48), prev3_tok=- (-3.09), prev2_tok=2 (-1.91).
